description: Estimate a crypto-to-crypto swap on HiddenSwap, a no-KYC crypto exchange. Returns the amount the person would receive after all fees, the rate, the minimum and maximum, the payout fee, the usual duration and a prefilled swap link. Uses a quote recorded in the last two hours when one matches the exact amount (floating rate only, labelled with its time), otherwise a live quote. Read-only: it creates no order and moves no funds. Coin ids come from search_coins (for example btc, xmr, usdttrc20). No account, no email and no ID needed to swap.

amount.description: Amount of the coin sent, as a decimal string with a dot, for example "0.05".

from.description: The coin sent. Coin id from search_coins, for example btc, xmr or usdttrc20 (USDT on Tron).

rateType.description: float (default): the rate is set when the deposit is confirmed. fixed: a rate held once the swap is started on the site, when the pair offers one.

to.description: The coin received. Coin id from search_coins, for example btc, xmr or usdttrc20 (USDT on Tron).

name: get_quote

amountTo.description: Estimated amount received, after all fees.

etaMinutes.description: Usual duration in minutes: low and high.

payoutFee.description: Fee for sending the new coins, in the received coin. Already taken off amountTo.

rate.description: How much of the received coin one unit of the sent coin buys, before the payout fee.

swapUrl.description: Prefilled swap page. The person reviews and starts the swap there.

title: Get a swap estimate
